uk.R: Серед нащадків Юди були Фарес, Есром, Кармі, Хур і Шовал.

decisions.choice: sons: descendants in a line, one generation after another
decisions.reason: These five are not brothers. Perez was Judah's son (Genesis 38:29), Hezron was Perez's son (Genesis 46:12), Hur was a grandson of Hezron through Caleb (2:18-19), and Shobal was Hur's son (2:50). "Sons" here means descendants, and the list traces one line down from Judah, picking up the family of 2:50-55.

decisions.choice: Carmi: a name standing where Caleb (Chelubai) is expected
decisions.reason: In 2:7 Carmi belongs to the line of Zerah, not Perez (compare Joshua 7:1). In this line the son of Hezron should be Caleb, also spelled Chelubai (2:9, 18). The name may have been changed in copying, or another Carmi may be meant; the text gives no more information.

decisions.choice: the chapter resumes the clans of Judah from chapter 2
decisions.reason: Chapters 2 and 4 together give the families of Judah, the tribe of David. This chapter adds short notes on clans and the towns they settled in the south, many of them not mentioned anywhere else.

decisions.choice: descendants included
decisions.reason: Readable says "descendants" because the five names are successive generations, not brothers (see the meaning note).

decisions.choice: "Entre los descendientes de Judá estaban"
decisions.reason: The five names are successive generations, not brothers (m1), so Readable says "descendientes", as the English says "descendants included".

decisions.choice: "자손 가운데는 ...이 있었다"
decisions.reason: The five names are generations one after another, not brothers; Readable says "descendants", as the English does.

decisions.choice: Os filhos de X: (L, B), Os filhos de X foram (R); gerou (L), foi o pai de (B, R); the name forms of Genesis 38 and 46, Numbers 26 and Ruth 4
decisions.reason: The genealogy formulas set in 1:5 and 1:10 are kept unchanged. The names keep the forms already set: Perez, Hezrom and Carmi as Genesis 46:9-12, Hur as Exodus 17:10, Sobal as Genesis 36:20. Readable says "Entre os descendentes ... estavam", since the five are generations, not brothers (m1).

decisions.choice: rare names spelled by the patterns of Genesis 46
decisions.reason: For this chapter: names found nowhere else in the drafted books are spelled by the patterns Genesis 46:9 sets for Portuguese ("qu" for the k-sound, a final -e after a consonant Portuguese cannot end on, -om for -on, -ã for -an, -ias for -iah, an unsounded h dropped): Aumai, Laade, Hazelelponi, Auzão, Haastari, Quelube, Estom, Teína, Ir-Naás, Meonotai, Ge-Harasim, Jealelel, Jecutiel, Bitia, Zoete, Bete-Asbeia, Jasubi-Leém, Netaim and the like. Better-known names keep their usual forms (Tecoa, Efrata, Belém, Queila, Maressa, Gedera, Socó, Zanoa, Estemoa, Zife, as Joshua 15 and 2 Samuel). A reviewer should confirm the rarer forms.

decisions.choice: names in their forms on main: "ፋሬስ", "ኤስሮን" (Genesis 46:12), "ከርሚ", "ሆር" (Exodus 31:2; 1 Chronicles 2:19-20), "ሦባል" (Genesis 36:20), "ካሌብ", "ቄኔዝ", "ጎቶንያል", "ዮፎኒ", "ሴሎም", "ዔር"; towns as Joshua 15 ("ጾርዓ", "ጌዶር", "ሶኮ", "ዛኖዋ", "ቅዒላ", "መሪሳ", "ኤሽትሞዓ", "ግዴራ"); names found nowhere else on main are written close to the Hebrew sounds
decisions.reason: Chapter 4 retells families and towns already named in Genesis, Numbers and Joshua, so each name keeps its Amharic form on main where the Hebrew is the same; names that appear only here have no earlier Amharic form.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The English of this chapter has deity_pronoun spans (verse 10). The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic, and the Amharic text has no such spans.

decisions.choice: "ユダの子ら" (L, B), "ユダの子孫" (R), not "息子"
decisions.reason: The five are generations one after another, not brothers (meaning decision); Balanced keeps the open "子ら" rather than the "息子は" of the lists before, and Readable says descendants, as its English does.

source.text: וּרְאָיָ֤ה בֶן־שׁוֹבָל֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יַ֔חַת וְיַ֣חַת הֹלִ֔יד אֶת־אֲחוּמַ֖י וְאֶת־לָ֑הַד אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַצָּֽרְעָתִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And Reaiah son of Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad; these [were the] clans of the Zorathite[s].

en.L: And Reaiah son of Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad. These [were the] clans of the Zorathites.
en.B: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
en.R: Shobal's son Reaiah was the father of Jahath. Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the people of Zorah.

es.L: Y Reaía hijo de Sobal engendró a Jahat, y Jahat engendró a Ahumai y a Lahad. Estos [fueron los] clanes de los zoratitas.
es.B: Reaía hijo de Sobal fue padre de Jahat, y Jahat fue padre de Ahumai y de Lahad. Estos fueron los clanes de los zoratitas.
es.R: Reaía, hijo de Sobal, fue padre de Jahat. Jahat fue padre de Ahumai y de Lahad. Estos fueron los clanes de la gente de Zora.

fr.L: Et Reaya, fils de Shobal, engendra Yahath, et Yahath engendra Ahoumaï et Lahad. Ce [sont] les clans des Tsoreatites.
fr.B: Reaya, fils de Shobal, fut le père de Yahath, et Yahath fut le père d’Ahoumaï et de Lahad. Ce sont les clans des Tsoreatites.
fr.R: Reaya, le fils de Shobal, a eu pour fils Yahath. Yahath a eu pour fils Ahoumaï et Lahad. Ce sont les clans des gens de Tsorea.

sw.L: Na Reaya mwana wa Shobali alimzaa Yahathi, na Yahathi alimzaa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizi [zilikuwa] koo za Wasorathi.
sw.B: Reaya mwana wa Shobali alikuwa baba wa Yahathi, na Yahathi alikuwa baba wa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wasorathi.
sw.R: Reaya mwana wa Shobali alikuwa baba wa Yahathi. Yahathi alikuwa baba wa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za watu wa Sora.

vi.L: Và Rê-a-gia con trai Sô-banh sinh Gia-hát, và Gia-hát sinh A-hu-mai và La-hát. Đó [là] các họ hàng của người Xô-ra-tít.
vi.B: Rê-a-gia con trai Sô-banh là cha của Gia-hát, và Gia-hát là cha của A-hu-mai và La-hát. Đó là các gia tộc của người Xô-ra-tít.
vi.R: Rê-a-gia, con trai của Sô-banh, là cha của Gia-hát. Gia-hát là cha của A-hu-mai và La-hát. Đó là các gia tộc của dân thành Xô-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 소발의 아들 르아야는 야핫을 낳고, 야핫은 아후매와 라핫을 낳았다. 이들이 소라 사람의 씨족들이다.
ko.B: 소발의 아들 르아야는 야핫을 낳고, 야핫은 아후매와 라핫을 낳았다. 이들이 소라 사람의 씨족들이었다.
ko.R: 소발의 아들 르아야는 야핫을 낳았다. 야핫은 아후매와 라핫을 낳았다. 이들이 소라에 사는 사람들의 씨족들이었다.

pt.L: E Reaías, filho de Sobal, gerou Jaate, e Jaate gerou Aumai e Laade. Estes [eram] os clãs dos zoratitas.
pt.B: Reaías, filho de Sobal, foi o pai de Jaate, e Jaate foi o pai de Aumai e Laade. Esses foram os clãs dos zoratitas.
pt.R: Reaías, filho de Sobal, foi o pai de Jaate. Jaate foi o pai de Aumai e Laade. Esses foram os clãs do povo de Zorá.

am.L: የሦባልም ልጅ ራያ ያሐትን ወለደ፤ ያሐትም አሑማይንና ላሀድን ወለደ። እነዚህ የጾርዓታውያን ጎሳዎች [ነበሩ]።

am.R: የሦባል ልጅ ራያ የያሐት አባት ነበረ፤ ያሐትም የአሑማይና የላሀድ አባት ነበረ። እነዚህ የጾርዓ ከተማ ሰዎች ጎሳዎች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और शोबाल के पुत्र रायाह ने यहत को उत्पन्न किया, और यहत ने अहूमै और लहद को उत्पन्न किया। ये सोराइयों के कुल [थे]।
hi.B: शोबाल का पुत्र रायाह यहत का पिता था, और यहत अहूमै और लहद का पिता था। ये सोराइयों के कुल थे।
hi.R: शोबाल का बेटा रायाह यहत का पिता था। यहत अहूमै और लहद का पिता था। ये सोरा के लोगों के कुल थे।

ru.L: И Реаия, сын Шовала, родил Иахафа, а Иахаф родил Ахумая и Лахада. Это роды цорафитян.
ru.B: Реаия, сын Шовала, был отцом Иахафа, а Иахаф был отцом Ахумая и Лахада. Это были роды цорафитян.
ru.R: Сын Шовала Реаия был отцом Иахафа. Иахаф был отцом Ахумая и Лахада. Это были роды жителей Цоры.

ja.L: そしてショバルの子レアヤはヤハトをもうけ、ヤハトはアフマイとラハドをもうけた。これらがツォルアト人の氏族である。
ja.B: ショバルの子レアヤはヤハトの父となり、ヤハトはアフマイとラハドの父となった。これらがツォルアト人の氏族であった。
ja.R: ショバルの息子レアヤはヤハトの父でした。ヤハトはアフマイとラハドの父でした。この人たちが、ツォルアの人々の一族でした。

uk.L: І Реая, син Шовала, породив Ягата, а Ягат породив Ахумая і Лагада. Це роди цоратійців.
uk.B: Реая, син Шовала, був батьком Ягата, а Ягат був батьком Ахумая і Лагада. Це були роди цоратійців.
uk.R: Син Шовала Реая був батьком Ягата. Ягат був батьком Ахумая і Лагада. Це були роди жителів Цори.

decisions.choice: Reaiah: probably the same man as Haroeh son of Shobal in 2:52
decisions.reason: In 2:52 Shobal's son is called Haroeh, a name very close in spelling to Reaiah; the two lists seem to describe the same family.

decisions.choice: the Zorathites: the people of Zorah
decisions.reason: Zorah was a town in the low hills west of Jerusalem (Joshua 15:33), the home of Samson's family (Judges 13:2). In 2:53 the Zorathites are counted among Shobal's descendants.

decisions.choice: the people of Zorah
decisions.reason: Readable names the town instead of using the clan name "Zorathites".

decisions.choice: os zoratitas (L, B); o povo de Zorá (R)
decisions.reason: The clan name is formed on "Zorá", the town as Joshua 15:33 and Judges 13:2 spell it in Portuguese, with the "-itas" of the clan names in Numbers 26. Readable names the town, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Xም Yን ወለደ" (L); "X የY አባት ነበረ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the "begot" chains of chapters 3-5: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb, as the Amharic Genesis genealogies do; Balanced and Readable say "was the father of", as the Amharic Matthew 1 does.

decisions.choice: "ጾርዓታውያን" (L, B); "የጾርዓ ከተማ ሰዎች" (R)
decisions.reason: The clan name (Zorathites) is formed from "ጾርዓ", the Amharic form of Zorah in Joshua 15:33 and Judges 13:2, as in 1 Chronicles 2:53, and kept apart from the Zorites of 2:54 ("ጾርዓውያን"); Readable names the town, as the English does.

source.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֲבִ֣י עֵיטָ֔ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיִשְׁמָ֖א וְיִדְבָּ֑שׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אֲחוֹתָ֖ם הַצְלֶלְפּֽוֹנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [were the] father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and [the] name of their sister [was] Hazzelelponi.

en.L: And these [were of the] father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and [the] name of their sister [was] Hazzelelponi.
en.B: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
en.R: These were the sons of the founder of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. They had a sister named Hazzelelponi.

es.L: Y estos [fueron los hijos del] padre de Etam: Jezreel, e Isma, e Idbas; y [el] nombre de su hermana [era] Hazelelponi.
es.B: Estos fueron los hijos del padre de Etam: Jezreel, Isma e Idbas. Su hermana se llamaba Hazelelponi.
es.R: Estos fueron los hijos del fundador de Etam: Jezreel, Isma e Idbas. Tenían una hermana llamada Hazelelponi.

fr.L: Et ceux-ci [étaient du] père d’Étam : Jizreël, et Yishma, et Yidbash ; et le nom de leur sœur [était] Hatslelponi.
fr.B: Voici les fils du père d’Étam : Jizreël, Yishma et Yidbash. Leur sœur s’appelait Hatslelponi.
fr.R: Voici les fils du fondateur d’Étam : Jizreël, Yishma et Yidbash. Ils avaient une sœur, qui s’appelait Hatslelponi.

sw.L: Na hawa [walikuwa wa] baba wa Etamu: Yezreeli, na Ishma, na Idbashi; na jina la dada yao [lilikuwa] Haselelponi.
sw.B: Hawa walikuwa wana wa baba wa Etamu: Yezreeli, Ishma na Idbashi. Dada yao aliitwa Haselelponi.
sw.R: Hawa walikuwa wana wa mwanzilishi wa Etamu: Yezreeli, Ishma na Idbashi. Walikuwa na dada aitwaye Haselelponi.

vi.L: Và đây [là các con trai của] cha của Ê-tam: Gít-rê-ên, Dít-ma và Di-ba; và tên em gái của họ [là] Ha-xê-lên-phô-ni.
vi.B: Đây là các con trai của cha của Ê-tam: Gít-rê-ên, Dít-ma và Di-ba. Em gái của họ tên là Ha-xê-lên-phô-ni.
vi.R: Đây là các con trai của người lập ra thành Ê-tam: Gít-rê-ên, Dít-ma và Di-ba. Họ có một em gái tên là Ha-xê-lên-phô-ni.

ko.L: 그리고 이들은 에담의 아버지[의 아들들]이다. 이스르엘과 이스마와 잇바스. 그리고 그들의 누이의 이름은 하술렐보니이다.
ko.B: 에담의 아버지의 아들들은 이스르엘과 이스마와 잇바스였다. 그들의 누이의 이름은 하술렐보니였다.
ko.R: 에담을 세운 사람의 아들들은 이스르엘, 이스마, 잇바스였다. 그들에게는 하술렐보니라는 누이가 있었다.

pt.L: E estes [eram os filhos do] pai de Etã: Jezreel, e Isma, e Idbás; e o nome da irmã deles [era] Hazelelponi.
pt.B: Estes foram os filhos do pai de Etã: Jezreel, Isma e Idbás. A irmã deles se chamava Hazelelponi.
pt.R: Estes foram os filhos do fundador de Etã: Jezreel, Isma e Idbás. Eles tinham uma irmã chamada Hazelelponi.

am.L: እነዚህም የኤጣም አባት [ልጆች ነበሩ]፤ ኢይዝራኤል፣ ይሽማና ይድባሽ፤ የእኅታቸውም ስም ሐጽሌልፎኒ [ነበረ]።
am.B: የኤጣም አባት ልጆች ኢይዝራኤል፣ ይሽማና ይድባሽ ነበሩ። የእኅታቸውም ስም ሐጽሌልፎኒ ነበረ።
am.R: የኤጣም ከተማ መሥራች ልጆች ኢይዝራኤል፣ ይሽማና ይድባሽ ነበሩ። ሐጽሌልፎኒ የምትባል እኅትም ነበረቻቸው።

hi.L: और ये एताम के पिता के [थे]: यिज्रेल, और यिश्मा, और यिदबाश; और उनकी बहन का नाम हस्सलेलपोनी [था]।
hi.B: एताम के पिता के पुत्र ये थे: यिज्रेल, यिश्मा और यिदबाश। उनकी बहन का नाम हस्सलेलपोनी था।
hi.R: एताम को बसानेवाले के बेटे ये थे: यिज्रेल, यिश्मा और यिदबाश। उनकी एक बहन भी थी, जिसका नाम हस्सलेलपोनी था।

ru.L: И эти [были от] отца Етама: Изреель, и Ишма, и Идбаш; и имя их сестры — Хаццелелпони.
ru.B: Вот сыновья отца Етама: Изреель, Ишма и Идбаш. Их сестру звали Хаццелелпони.
ru.R: Вот сыновья основателя Етама: Изреель, Ишма и Идбаш. У них была сестра по имени Хаццелелпони.

ja.L: そしてこれらはエタムの父の[子ら]。イズレエル、イシュマ、イドバシュ。そして彼らの姉妹の名はハツレルポニ[であった]。
ja.B: エタムの父の息子は、イズレエル、イシュマ、イドバシュであった。彼らの姉妹の名はハツレルポニといった。
ja.R: エタムの町を築いた人の息子は、イズレエル、イシュマ、イドバシュでした。三人には、ハツレルポニという姉妹がいました。

uk.L: І ці [були від] батька Етаму: Їзреель, і Їшма, і Їдбаш; а імʼя їхньої сестри — Гаццелелпоні.
uk.B: Ось сини батька Етаму: Їзреель, Їшма і Їдбаш. Їхню сестру звали Гаццелелпоні.
uk.R: Ось сини засновника Етаму: Їзреель, Їшма і Їдбаш. У них була сестра на імʼя Гаццелелпоні.

decisions.choice: these were the sons of the father of Etam
alternatives: these were the father of Etam (as the Hebrew stands)
these are the sons of Etam
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads only "these [were] the father of Etam", which does not fit the list of three names that follows. The ancient Greek translation reads "these are the sons of Etam". A word meaning "sons" seems to have dropped out in copying, and the list is read as the sons of Etam's founder.

decisions.choice: father of a town: its founder, or the head of the clan that settled it
alternatives: the father of a son with that name
decisions.reason: As at 2:24: "father" of a town means its founder, or the ancestor of the clan that lived there. The title comes many times in this chapter (verses 4, 5, 12, 17, 18, 19, 21).

decisions.choice: Etam and Jezreel: places of Judah's hill country
decisions.reason: This Etam was a town near Bethlehem, later fortified by Rehoboam (2 Chronicles 11:6); a different Etam belonged to Simeon (verse 32). Jezreel here is a clan named like the town of Judah (Joshua 15:56), not the northern valley. A daughter is named in the list, as in 2:16 and 3:9.

decisions.choice: the sons of
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "the sons of" so the sentence makes sense (see the text note). Literal brackets the supplied words.

decisions.choice: the founder of
decisions.reason: Readable says "founder of" where "father of" is followed by a town, as at 2:24. Literal and Balanced keep "father of".

decisions.choice: "[los hijos del] padre de Etam" (L); "los hijos del padre de Etam" (B); "los hijos del fundador de Etam" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads only "these, the father of Etam" (m1); Spanish, like the English, supplies "los hijos de", in brackets at Literal.

decisions.choice: mwanzilishi wa
decisions.reason: As at 2:24, Readable says "mwanzilishi wa" (founder of) where "father of" is followed by a town; Literal and Balanced keep "baba wa".

decisions.choice: "em gái" for the one daughter named after her brothers
decisions.reason: Vietnamese names a sister as older or younger; a daughter named after her brothers is taken as the younger, as with Tamar (3:9).

decisions.choice: pai (L, B); fundador (R)
decisions.reason: For the chapter: where "father of" is followed by a town (m2), Literal and Balanced keep "pai de" and Readable says "fundador de", as the English does with "founder". "Etã" is the form of Judges 15:8 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "የ… አባት" (L, B); "የ… ከተማ መሥራች" (R), for "father of" a town
decisions.reason: As the English does (m2), Literal and Balanced keep "father of" a town, and Readable says "founder" ("መሥራች"); the same holds for the rest of the chapter. "ኤጣም" is as in Judges 15:8.

source.text: וּפְנוּאֵל֙ אֲבִ֣י גְדֹ֔ר וְעֵ֖זֶר אֲבִ֣י חוּשָׁ֑ה אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־חוּר֙ בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֔תָה אֲבִ֖י בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Penuel [the] father of Gedor, and Ezer [the] father of Hushah; these [were the] sons of Hur, [the] firstborn of Ephrathah, [the] father of Bethlehem.

en.L: And Penuel [was the] father of Gedor, and Ezer [the] father of Hushah. These [were the] sons of Hur, [the] firstborn of Ephrathah, [the] father of Bethlehem.
en.B: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
en.R: Penuel was the founder of Gedor, and Ezer was the founder of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur. Hur was the oldest son of Ephrathah, and he was the founder of Bethlehem.

es.L: Y Penuel [fue el] padre de Gedor, y Ezer [el] padre de Husa. Estos [fueron los] hijos de Hur, [el] primogénito de Efrata, [el] padre de Belén.
es.B: Penuel fue padre de Gedor, y Ezer, padre de Husa. Estos fueron los hijos de Hur, el primogénito de Efrata y padre de Belén.
es.R: Penuel fue el fundador de Gedor, y Ezer fue el fundador de Husa. Estos fueron los descendientes de Hur. Hur era el hijo mayor de Efrata, y fue el fundador de Belén.

fr.L: Et Penouel [était le] père de Guedor, et Ézer, père de Housha. Ce [sont] les fils de Hour, premier-né d’Éphrata, père de Bethléem.
fr.B: Penouel était le père de Guedor, et Ézer le père de Housha. Ce sont les fils de Hour, premier-né d’Éphrata et père de Bethléem.
fr.R: Penouel a été le fondateur de Guedor, et Ézer le fondateur de Housha. C’étaient des descendants de Hour. Hour était le fils aîné d’Éphrata, et il a été le fondateur de Bethléem.

sw.L: Na Penueli [alikuwa] baba wa Gedori, na Ezeri baba wa Husha. Hawa [walikuwa] wana wa Huri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Efrata, baba wa Bethlehemu.
sw.B: Penueli alikuwa baba wa Gedori, na Ezeri baba wa Husha. Hao ndio waliokuwa wana wa Huri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Efrata na baba wa Bethlehemu.
sw.R: Penueli alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Gedori, na Ezeri alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Husha. Hao ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Huri. Huri alikuwa mwana mkubwa wa Efrata, naye alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Bethlehemu.

vi.L: Và Phê-nu-ên [là] cha của Ghê-đô, và Ê-xe [là] cha của Hu-sa. Đó [là] các con trai của Hu-rơ, con đầu lòng của Ép-ra-ta, cha của Bết-lê-hem.
vi.B: Phê-nu-ên là cha của Ghê-đô, và Ê-xe là cha của Hu-sa. Đó là các con trai của Hu-rơ, con đầu lòng của Ép-ra-ta và là cha của Bết-lê-hem.
vi.R: Phê-nu-ên là người lập ra thành Ghê-đô, và Ê-xe là người lập ra thành Hu-sa. Đó là con cháu của Hu-rơ. Hu-rơ là con trai cả của Ép-ra-ta, và ông là người lập ra thành Bết-lê-hem.

ko.L: 그리고 브누엘은 그돌의 아버지이고, 에셀은 후사의 아버지이다. 이들이 베들레헴의 아버지, 곧 에브라다의 맏아들 훌의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 브누엘은 그돌의 아버지였고, 에셀은 후사의 아버지였다. 이들은 에브라다의 맏아들이며 베들레헴의 아버지인 훌의 아들들이었다.
ko.R: 브누엘은 그돌을 세웠고, 에셀은 후사를 세웠다. 이들은 훌의 자손이었다. 훌은 에브라다의 맏아들이었고, 베들레헴을 세운 사람이었다.

pt.L: E Penuel [era o] pai de Gedor, e Ézer, [o] pai de Husá. Estes [eram os] filhos de Hur, [o] primogênito de Efrata, [o] pai de Belém.
pt.B: Penuel foi o pai de Gedor, e Ézer, o pai de Husá. Esses foram os filhos de Hur, o primogênito de Efrata e pai de Belém.
pt.R: Penuel foi o fundador de Gedor, e Ézer foi o fundador de Husá. Esses foram os descendentes de Hur. Hur era o filho mais velho de Efrata e foi o fundador de Belém.

am.L: ፋኑኤልም የጌዶር አባት፣ ኤጽርም የኩሳ አባት [ነበሩ]። እነዚህ የኤፍራታ በኩር የሆር ልጆች፣ የቤተ ልሔም አባት [ልጆች] ነበሩ።
am.B: ፋኑኤል የጌዶር አባት፣ ኤጽርም የኩሳ አባት ነበሩ። እነዚህ የኤፍራታ በኩርና የቤተ ልሔም አባት የሆነው የሆር ልጆች ነበሩ።
am.R: ፋኑኤል የጌዶር ከተማ መሥራች ነበረ፤ ኤጽርም የኩሳ ከተማ መሥራች ነበረ። እነዚህ የሆር ዘሮች ነበሩ። ሆር የኤፍራታ የመጀመሪያ ልጅ ነበረ፤ የቤተ ልሔም ከተማ መሥራችም እርሱ ነበረ።

hi.L: और पनूएल गदोर का पिता [था], और एज़ेर हूशा का पिता। ये बैतलहम के पिता, एप्राता के पहलौठे हूर के पुत्र [थे]।
hi.B: पनूएल गदोर का पिता था, और एज़ेर हूशा का पिता। ये हूर के पुत्र थे, जो एप्राता का पहलौठा और बैतलहम का पिता था।
hi.R: पनूएल गदोर को बसानेवाला था, और एज़ेर हूशा को बसानेवाला। ये हूर के वंशज थे। हूर एप्राता का सबसे बड़ा बेटा था, और वह बैतलहम को बसानेवाला था।

ru.L: И Пенуэл [был] отцом Гедора, а Эцер — отцом Хуши. Это сыновья Ора, первенца Ефрафы, отца Вифлеема.
ru.B: Пенуэл был отцом Гедора, а Эцер — отцом Хуши. Это были сыновья Ора, первенца Ефрафы и отца Вифлеема.
ru.R: Пенуэл был основателем Гедора, а Эцер — основателем Хуши. Это были потомки Ора. Ор был старшим сыном Ефрафы и основателем Вифлеема.

ja.L: そしてペヌエルはゲドルの父、エゼルはフシャの父[であった]。これらは、ベツレヘムの父、エフラタの長子フルの子らである。
ja.B: ペヌエルはゲドルの父、エゼルはフシャの父であった。これらは、エフラタの長子でベツレヘムの父であるフルの子らである。
ja.R: ペヌエルはゲドルの町を築いた人で、エゼルはフシャの町を築いた人でした。この人たちはフルの子孫です。フルはエフラタのいちばん上の息子で、ベツレヘムの町を築いた人でした。

uk.L: І Пенуїл — батько Гедора, і Езер — батько Хуші. Це сини Хура, первістка Ефрати, батька Вифлеєма.
uk.B: Пенуїл був батьком Гедора, а Езер — батьком Хуші. Це були сини Хура, первістка Ефрати і батька Вифлеєма.
uk.R: Пенуїл був засновником Гедора, а Езер — засновником Хуші. Це були нащадки Хура. Хур був найстаршим сином Ефрати і засновником Вифлеєма.

decisions.choice: Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Caleb's eldest son by his wife Ephrathah
decisions.reason: Ephrathah was the wife of Caleb son of Hezron, and Hur was her first son (2:19, 50). Ephrathah is also an old name for Bethlehem and its district (Genesis 35:19; Ruth 4:11; Micah 5:1), so the clan and its town share the name.

decisions.choice: father of Bethlehem: founder of the town
decisions.reason: In 2:51 Hur's son Salma is called the father of Bethlehem. Here the title is given to Hur, the head of the whole clan; the two notes fit together if the town was founded by Hur's family. "Father of" a town is explained at verse 3.

decisions.choice: Gedor and Hushah: towns of Judah's hill country
decisions.reason: Gedor is listed in Joshua 15:58. Hushah was the home of Sibbecai the Hushathite, one of David's warriors (2 Samuel 21:18).

decisions.choice: founder; oldest son
decisions.reason: Readable says "founder" for "father of" a town, as at verse 3, and "oldest son" for "firstborn".

decisions.choice: Gedor, Husá, Efrata, Belém
decisions.reason: Gedor keeps the form of Joshua 15:58, Efrata and Belém the forms of Genesis 35:19. Hushah is "Husá", the town from which 2 Samuel 21:18 calls Sibbecai "o husatita".

decisions.choice: "ኩሳ" (Hushah), from "ኩሳታዊው" in 2 Samuel 21:18; "ኤፍራታ" as Ruth 4:11; "ፋኑኤል" as Judges 8:8
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms already on main for the same Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "エゼル" (Ezer), kept apart from Seir's son "エツェル" (1:38)
decisions.reason: The two names are spelled with different Hebrew letters (here a z-sound, there ts); the English writes both Ezer, the Japanese keeps them apart.

source.text: וּלְאַשְׁחוּר֙ אֲבִ֣י תְק֔וֹעַ הָי֖וּ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים חֶלְאָ֖ה וְנַעֲרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And to Ashhur [the] father of Tekoa were two wives, Helah and Naarah.

en.L: And Ashhur [the] father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
en.B: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
en.R: Ashhur, the founder of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

es.L: Y Asur, [el] padre de Tecoa, tuvo dos mujeres, Hela y Naara.
es.B: Asur, padre de Tecoa, tuvo dos mujeres, Hela y Naara.
es.R: Asur, el fundador de Tecoa, tuvo dos esposas, Hela y Naara.

fr.L: Et Ashhour, père de Teqoa, eut deux femmes, Héla et Naara.
fr.B: Ashhour, père de Teqoa, eut deux femmes, Héla et Naara.
fr.R: Ashhour, le fondateur de Teqoa, avait deux femmes, Héla et Naara.

sw.L: Na Ashhuri baba wa Tekoa alikuwa na wake wawili, Hela na Naara.
sw.B: Ashhuri baba wa Tekoa alikuwa na wake wawili, Hela na Naara.
sw.R: Ashhuri, mwanzilishi wa Tekoa, alikuwa na wake wawili, Hela na Naara.

vi.L: Và Át-hu-rơ cha của Thê-cô-a có hai vợ, Hê-la và Na-a-ra.
vi.B: Át-hu-rơ, cha của Thê-cô-a, có hai vợ là Hê-la và Na-a-ra.
vi.R: Át-hu-rơ, người lập ra thành Thê-cô-a, có hai vợ là Hê-la và Na-a-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 드고아의 아버지 아스훌에게 두 아내, 헬라와 나아라가 있었다.
ko.B: 드고아의 아버지 아스훌에게는 헬라와 나아라라는 두 아내가 있었다.
ko.R: 드고아를 세운 아스훌에게는 헬라와 나아라라는 두 아내가 있었다.

pt.L: E Asur, [o] pai de Tecoa, teve duas mulheres, Helá e Naará.
pt.B: Asur, o pai de Tecoa, teve duas mulheres, Helá e Naará.
pt.R: Asur, o fundador de Tecoa, tinha duas mulheres, Helá e Naará.

am.L: ለቴቁሔ አባት ለአሽሑርም ሁለት ሚስቶች ነበሩት፤ ሔላና ነዕራ።
am.B: የቴቁሔ አባት አሽሑር ሔላና ነዕራ የተባሉ ሁለት ሚስቶች ነበሩት።
am.R: የቴቁሔ ከተማ መሥራች አሽሑር ሔላና ነዕራ የተባሉ ሁለት ሚስቶች ነበሩት።

hi.L: और तकोआ के पिता अशहूर की दो पत्नियाँ थीं, हेला और नारा।
hi.B: तकोआ के पिता अशहूर की दो पत्नियाँ थीं, हेला और नारा।
hi.R: तकोआ को बसानेवाले अशहूर की दो पत्नियाँ थीं, हेला और नारा।

ru.L: И у Ашхура, отца Фекои, было две жены, Хела и Наара.
ru.B: У Ашхура, отца Фекои, было две жены, Хела и Наара.
ru.R: У Ашхура, основателя Фекои, было две жены, Хела и Наара.

ja.L: そしてテコアの父アシュフルには、二人の妻ヘラとナアラがいた。
ja.B: テコアの父アシュフルには、ヘラとナアラという二人の妻がいた。
ja.R: テコアの町を築いたアシュフルには、ヘラとナアラという二人の妻がいました。

uk.L: І в Ашхура, батька Текоа, були дві жінки, Хела і Наара.
uk.B: Ашхур, батько Текоа, мав дві дружини, Хелу і Наару.
uk.R: Ашхур, засновник Текоа, мав дві дружини, Хелу і Наару.

decisions.choice: Ashhur: the son of Hezron born after his father's death
decisions.reason: According to 2:24, Ashhur was born to Hezron's wife Abijah after Hezron died, and he is there also called the father of Tekoa.

decisions.choice: Tekoa: a town south of Bethlehem
decisions.reason: Tekoa stood on the edge of the wilderness of Judah. It was the home of the wise woman sent to David (2 Samuel 14:2) and of the prophet Amos (Amos 1:1).

decisions.choice: had
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "to Ashhur were two wives", the usual way of saying "had". Literal uses "had" since the word for word form is clumsy, and the gloss shows it.

decisions.choice: "ቴቁሔ", as 2 Samuel 14:2
decisions.reason: Tekoa keeps the Amharic form of 2 Samuel 14:2 (m2).

source.text: וַתֵּ֨לֶד ל֤וֹ נַעֲרָה֙ אֶת־אֲחֻזָּ֣ם וְאֶת־חֵ֔פֶר וְאֶת־תֵּימְנִ֖י וְאֶת־הָאֲחַשְׁתָּרִ֑י אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י נַעֲרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And bore to him Naarah Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and the Ahashtari; these [were the] sons of Naarah.

en.L: And Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These [were the] sons of Naarah.
en.B: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
en.R: Naarah gave birth to Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari for him. These were Naarah's sons.

es.L: Y Naara le dio a luz a Ahuzam, y a Hefer, y a Temeni, y a Haahastari. Estos [fueron los] hijos de Naara.
es.B: Naara le dio a luz a Ahuzam, Hefer, Temeni y Haahastari. Estos fueron los hijos de Naara.
es.R: Naara tuvo con él a Ahuzam, Hefer, Temeni y Haahastari. Estos fueron los hijos de Naara.

fr.L: Et Naara lui enfanta Ahouzzam, et Hépher, et Témeni, et Haahashtari. Ce [sont] les fils de Naara.
fr.B: Naara lui donna Ahouzzam, Hépher, Témeni et Haahashtari. Ce sont les fils de Naara.
fr.R: Naara a eu de lui Ahouzzam, Hépher, Témeni et Haahashtari. Ce sont les fils de Naara.

sw.L: Na Naara akamzalia Ahuzamu, na Heferi, na Temeni, na Haahashtari. Hawa [walikuwa] wana wa Naara.
sw.B: Naara alimzalia Ahuzamu, Heferi, Temeni na Haahashtari. Hao ndio waliokuwa wana wa Naara.
sw.R: Naara alimzalia Ahuzamu, Heferi, Temeni na Haahashtari. Hao walikuwa wana wa Naara.

vi.L: Và Na-a-ra sinh cho ông A-hu-xam, Hê-phe, Thê-mê-ni và Ha-a-hách-ta-ri. Đó [là] các con trai của Na-a-ra.
vi.B: Na-a-ra sinh cho ông A-hu-xam, Hê-phe, Thê-mê-ni và Ha-a-hách-ta-ri. Đó là các con trai của Na-a-ra.
vi.R: Na-a-ra sinh cho ông A-hu-xam, Hê-phe, Thê-mê-ni và Ha-a-hách-ta-ri. Đó là các con trai của Na-a-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 나아라가 그에게 아훗삼과 헤벨과 데므니와 하아하스다리를 낳아 주었다. 이들이 나아라의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 나아라는 그에게 아훗삼과 헤벨과 데므니와 하아하스다리를 낳아 주었다. 이들이 나아라의 아들들이었다.
ko.R: 나아라는 아스훌에게서 아훗삼, 헤벨, 데므니, 하아하스다리를 낳았다. 이들이 나아라의 아들들이었다.

pt.L: E Naará lhe deu à luz Auzão, e Héfer, e Temeni, e Haastari. Estes [eram os] filhos de Naará.
pt.B: Naará lhe deu Auzão, Héfer, Temeni e Haastari. Esses foram os filhos de Naará.
pt.R: Naará teve com ele os filhos Auzão, Héfer, Temeni e Haastari. Esses foram os filhos de Naará.

am.L: ነዕራም አሑዛምን፣ ሔፌርን፣ ቴምኒንና ሃአሕሽታሪን ወለደችለት። እነዚህ የነዕራ ልጆች [ነበሩ]።
am.B: ነዕራ አሑዛምን፣ ሔፌርን፣ ቴምኒንና ሃአሕሽታሪን ወለደችለት። እነዚህ የነዕራ ልጆች ነበሩ።
am.R: ነዕራ አሑዛምን፣ ሔፌርን፣ ቴምኒንና ሃአሕሽታሪን ወለደችለት። እነዚህ የነዕራ ልጆች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और नारा ने उसके लिए अहुज्जाम, और हेपेर, और तेमनी, और हाहशतारी को जना। ये नारा के पुत्र [थे]।
hi.B: नारा ने उसके लिए अहुज्जाम, हेपेर, तेमनी और हाहशतारी को जन्म दिया। ये नारा के पुत्र थे।
hi.R: नारा से अशहूर के ये बेटे हुए: अहुज्जाम, हेपेर, तेमनी और हाहशतारी। ये नारा के बेटे थे।

ru.L: И Наара родила ему Ахуззама, и Хефера, и Темени, и Гаахаштари. Это сыновья Наары.
ru.B: Наара родила ему Ахуззама, Хефера, Темени и Гаахаштари. Это были сыновья Наары.
ru.R: Наара родила ему Ахуззама, Хефера, Темени и Гаахаштари. Это были сыновья Наары.

ja.L: そしてナアラは彼に、アフザム、ヘフェル、テメニ、ハアハシュタリを産んだ。これらがナアラの子らである。
ja.B: ナアラはアシュフルに、アフザム、ヘフェル、テメニ、ハアハシュタリを産んだ。これらがナアラの息子たちであった。
ja.R: ナアラは、アシュフルとの間にアフザム、ヘフェル、テメニ、ハアハシュタリを産みました。これがナアラの息子たちです。

uk.L: І народила йому Наара Ахуззама, і Хефера, і Темені, і Гаахаштарі. Це сини Наари.
uk.B: Наара народила йому Ахуззама, Хефера, Темені і Гаахаштарі. Це були сини Наари.
uk.R: Наара народила йому Ахуззама, Хефера, Темені і Гаахаштарі. Це були сини Наари.

decisions.choice: Haahashtari: "the Ahashtarite", a clan name
decisions.reason: The last name has the article, "the Ahashtarite", the form of a clan or group rather than one man's name. Temeni can also mean "southerner". In these lists clans are often counted as sons.

decisions.choice: gave birth to
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday phrase for "bore".

source.text: וּבְנֵ֖י חֶלְאָ֑ה צֶ֥רֶת וְצֹ֖חַר וְאֶתְנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Helah: Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.

en.L: And [the] sons of Helah: Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.
en.B: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar and Ethnan.
en.R: Helah's sons were Zereth, Zohar and Ethnan.

es.L: Y [los] hijos de Hela: Zeret, y Zohar, y Etnán.
es.B: Los hijos de Hela: Zeret, Zohar y Etnán.
es.R: Los hijos de Hela fueron Zeret, Zohar y Etnán.

fr.L: Et les fils de Héla : Tséreth, et Tsohar, et Ethnân.
fr.B: Les fils de Héla : Tséreth, Tsohar et Ethnân.
fr.R: Héla a eu pour fils Tséreth, Tsohar et Ethnân.

sw.L: Na wana wa Hela: Serethi, na Sohari, na Ethnani.
sw.B: Wana wa Hela: Serethi, Sohari na Ethnani.
sw.R: Wana wa Hela walikuwa Serethi, Sohari na Ethnani.

vi.L: Và các con trai của Hê-la: Xê-rết, Xô-ha và Ết-nan.
vi.B: Các con trai của Hê-la là Xê-rết, Xô-ha và Ết-nan.
vi.R: Các con trai của Hê-la là Xê-rết, Xô-ha và Ết-nan.

ko.L: 그리고 헬라의 아들들은 세렛과 소할과 에드난이다.
ko.B: 헬라의 아들들은 세렛과 소할과 에드난이었다.
ko.R: 헬라의 아들들은 세렛, 소할, 에드난이었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Helá: Zerete, e Zoar, e Etnã.
pt.B: Os filhos de Helá: Zerete, Zoar e Etnã.
pt.R: Os filhos de Helá foram Zerete, Zoar e Etnã.

am.L: የሔላም ልጆች ጼሬት፣ ጾሐርና ኤትናን [ናቸው]።
am.B: የሔላ ልጆች ጼሬት፣ ጾሐርና ኤትናን ነበሩ።
am.R: የሔላ ልጆች ጼሬት፣ ጾሐርና ኤትናን ነበሩ።

hi.L: और हेला के पुत्र: सेरेत, और सोहर, और एतनान।
hi.B: हेला के पुत्र: सेरेत, सोहर और एतनान।
hi.R: हेला के बेटे सेरेत, सोहर और एतनान थे।

ru.L: И сыновья Хелы: Церет, и Цохар, и Етнан.
ru.B: Сыновья Хелы: Церет, Цохар и Етнан.
ru.R: У Хелы были сыновья Церет, Цохар и Етнан.

ja.L: そしてヘラの子ら。ツェレト、ツォハル、エトナン。
ja.B: ヘラの息子は、ツェレト、ツォハル、エトナンであった。
ja.R: ヘラの息子は、ツェレト、ツォハル、エトナンでした。

uk.L: І сини Хели: Церет, і Цохар, і Етнан.
uk.B: Сини Хели: Церет, Цохар і Етнан.
uk.R: Синами Хели були Церет, Цохар і Етнан.

decisions.choice: Zohar, as the text is read aloud
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell "Izhar", but the reading tradition marked in the margin of Hebrew manuscripts reads "and Zohar". The text followed here takes the reading tradition. The difference is only in the name.

decisions.choice: Zoar
decisions.reason: The reading followed (m1) is the name spelled "Zoar" in Portuguese, as Genesis 46:10 spells Simeon's son Zohar.

source.text: וְק֣וֹץ הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת־עָנ֖וּב וְאֶת־הַצֹּבֵבָ֑ה וּמִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת אֲחַרְחֵ֖ל בֶּן־הָרֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Koz begot Anub, and the Zobebah, and [the] clans of Aharhel son of Harum.

en.L: And Koz begot Anub, and Zobebah, and the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
en.B: Koz was the father of Anub and Zobebah, and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
en.R: Koz was the father of Anub and Zobebah. The clans of Aharhel son of Harum also came from him.

es.L: Y Cos engendró a Anub, y a Zobeba, y a los clanes de Aharhel hijo de Harum.
es.B: Cos fue padre de Anub y de Zobeba, y de los clanes de Aharhel hijo de Harum.
es.R: Cos fue padre de Anub y de Zobeba. También vinieron de él los clanes de Aharhel hijo de Harum.

fr.L: Et Qots engendra Anoub, et Tsobéba, et les clans d’Aharhel, fils de Haroum.
fr.B: Qots fut le père d’Anoub et de Tsobéba, et des clans d’Aharhel, fils de Haroum.
fr.R: Qots a eu pour fils Anoub et Tsobéba. Les clans d’Aharhel, fils de Haroum, descendent aussi de lui.

sw.L: Na Kosi alimzaa Anubu, na Sobeba, na koo za Aharheli mwana wa Harumu.
sw.B: Kosi alikuwa baba wa Anubu na Sobeba, na wa koo za Aharheli mwana wa Harumu.
sw.R: Kosi alikuwa baba wa Anubu na Sobeba. Koo za Aharheli mwana wa Harumu nazo zilitoka kwake.

vi.L: Và Cốt sinh A-núp và Xô-bê-ba, và các họ hàng của A-ha-hên con trai Ha-rum.
vi.B: Cốt là cha của A-núp và Xô-bê-ba, và của các gia tộc của A-ha-hên con trai Ha-rum.
vi.R: Cốt là cha của A-núp và Xô-bê-ba. Các gia tộc của A-ha-hên con trai Ha-rum cũng ra từ ông.

ko.L: 그리고 고스는 아눕과 소베바와 하룸의 아들 아하헬의 씨족들을 낳았다.
ko.B: 고스는 아눕과 소베바를 낳았고, 하룸의 아들 아하헬의 씨족들도 그에게서 나왔다.
ko.R: 고스는 아눕과 소베바를 낳았다. 하룸의 아들 아하헬의 씨족들도 고스에게서 나왔다.

pt.L: E Coz gerou Anube, e Zobeba, e os clãs de Aarel, filho de Harum.
pt.B: Coz foi o pai de Anube e de Zobeba, e dos clãs de Aarel, filho de Harum.
pt.R: Coz foi o pai de Anube e de Zobeba. Os clãs de Aarel, filho de Harum, também vieram dele.

am.L: ቆጽም ዓኑብንና ጾቤባን፣ የሃሩምንም ልጅ የአሐርሔልን ጎሳዎች ወለደ።
am.B: ቆጽ የዓኑብና የጾቤባ፣ የሃሩም ልጅ የአሐርሔል ጎሳዎችም አባት ነበረ።
am.R: ቆጽ የዓኑብና የጾቤባ አባት ነበረ። የሃሩም ልጅ የአሐርሔል ጎሳዎችም ከእርሱ የተገኙ ናቸው።

hi.L: और कोस ने अनूब, और सोबेबा, और हारूम के पुत्र अहर्हेल के कुलों को उत्पन्न किया।
hi.B: कोस अनूब और सोबेबा का, और हारूम के पुत्र अहर्हेल के कुलों का पिता था।
hi.R: कोस अनूब और सोबेबा का पिता था। हारूम के बेटे अहर्हेल के कुल भी उसी से निकले।

ru.L: И Коц родил Анува, и Цовеву, и роды Ахархела, сына Харума.
ru.B: Коц был отцом Анува и Цовевы, а также родов Ахархела, сына Харума.
ru.R: Коц был отцом Анува и Цовевы. От него произошли также роды Ахархела, сына Харума.

ja.L: そしてコツはアヌブとツォベバ、またハルムの子アハルヘルの氏族をもうけた。
ja.B: コツはアヌブとツォベバの父となり、またハルムの子アハルヘルの氏族の先祖となった。
ja.R: コツはアヌブとツォベバの父でした。ハルムの息子アハルヘルの一族も、コツから出ました。

uk.L: І Коц породив Анува, і Цовеву, і роди Ахархела, сина Гарума.
uk.B: Коц був батьком Анува і Цовеви, а також родів Ахархела, сина Гарума.
uk.R: Коц був батьком Анува і Цовеви. Від нього походять також роди Ахархела, сина Гарума.

decisions.choice: Koz: a new name with no link given to the names before
decisions.reason: The list does not say whose son Koz was. Like several names in this chapter, he seems to come from a separate family record that the writer has placed among the clans of Judah.

decisions.choice: begot ... the clans of Aharhel: Koz was the ancestor of these clans
decisions.reason: "Begot" covers not only sons but whole clans descended from Koz. Zobebah has the article in Hebrew, which may also mark a clan rather than a single person.

decisions.choice: also came from him
decisions.reason: Readable puts the clans in a sentence of their own, since "was the father of ... clans" is hard to follow.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י יַעְבֵּ֔ץ נִכְבָּ֖ד מֵאֶחָ֑יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ קָרְאָ֨ה שְׁמ֤וֹ יַעְבֵּץ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּ֥י יָלַ֖דְתִּי בְּעֹֽצֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And was Jabez honored more than his brothers; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, For I bore [him] in pain.

en.L: And Jabez was more honored than his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "For I bore [him] in pain."
en.B: Jabez was held in greater honor than his brothers. His mother gave him the name Jabez, for she said, "I bore him in pain."
en.R: Jabez was more respected than his brothers. When he was born, his mother called him Jabez. She said, "His birth was very painful for me."

es.L: Y Jabes fue más honrado que sus hermanos, y su madre llamó su nombre Jabes, diciendo: «Porque [lo] di a luz con dolor».
es.B: Jabes fue más honrado que sus hermanos. Su madre le puso por nombre Jabes, porque dijo: «Lo di a luz con dolor».
es.R: Jabes era más respetado que sus hermanos. Cuando nació, su madre lo llamó Jabes. Ella dijo: «Su nacimiento me causó mucho dolor».

fr.L: Et Yabets fut plus honoré que ses frères, et sa mère appela son nom Yabets, disant : « Car je [l’]ai enfanté dans la douleur. »
fr.B: Yabets fut plus honoré que ses frères. Sa mère lui avait donné le nom de Yabets, en disant : « Je l’ai mis au monde dans la douleur. »
fr.R: Yabets était plus respecté que ses frères. Quand il est né, sa mère l’a appelé Yabets. Elle a dit : « Sa naissance m’a fait beaucoup souffrir. »

sw.L: Na Yabesi aliheshimiwa kuliko ndugu zake, na mama yake akamwita jina lake Yabesi, akisema, "Kwa sababu nilimzaa kwa uchungu."
sw.B: Yabesi aliheshimiwa kuliko ndugu zake. Mama yake alikuwa amempa jina Yabesi, kwa maana alisema, "Nilimzaa kwa uchungu."
sw.R: Yabesi aliheshimiwa zaidi kuliko ndugu zake. Alipozaliwa, mama yake alimwita Yabesi. Alisema, "Kumzaa kwake kulinitia maumivu makubwa."

vi.L: Và Gia-bê được tôn trọng hơn các anh em mình, và mẹ ông đã gọi tên ông là Gia-bê, mà nói: "Vì tôi đã sinh [nó] trong đau đớn."
vi.B: Gia-bê được tôn trọng hơn các anh em mình. Mẹ ông đặt tên ông là Gia-bê, vì bà nói: "Tôi đã sinh nó trong đau đớn."
vi.R: Gia-bê được kính trọng hơn các anh em mình. Khi ông ra đời, mẹ ông đặt tên ông là Gia-bê. Bà nói: "Tôi sinh nó ra thật đau đớn."

ko.L: 그리고 야베스는 그의 형제들보다 더 존귀했다. 그리고 그의 어머니가 그의 이름을 야베스라고 부르며 말했다. "내가 고통 속에서 [그를] 낳았기 때문이다."
ko.B: 야베스는 그의 형제들보다 더 존경받는 사람이었다. 그의 어머니는 "내가 고통 속에서 그를 낳았다" 하면서 그의 이름을 야베스라고 지었다.
ko.R: 야베스는 그의 형제들보다 더 존경을 받았다. 그가 태어났을 때 그의 어머니는 그를 야베스라고 불렀다. 그녀는 "이 아이를 낳을 때 몹시 아팠다" 하고 말했다.

pt.L: E Jabez foi mais honrado do que os seus irmãos, e a sua mãe chamou o seu nome Jabez, dizendo: "Porque [o] dei à luz com dor."
pt.B: Jabez era mais respeitado do que os seus irmãos. A mãe lhe deu o nome de Jabez, pois disse: "Eu o dei à luz com dor."
pt.R: Jabez era mais respeitado do que os seus irmãos. Quando ele nasceu, a mãe lhe deu o nome de Jabez. Ela disse: "O parto dele me causou muita dor."

am.L: ያቤጽም ከወንድሞቹ የበለጠ ክብር ነበረው፤ እናቱም፦ «በሥቃይ ወለድኩት» ስትል ስሙን ያቤጽ ብላ አወጣችለት።
am.B: ያቤጽ ከወንድሞቹ ይልቅ የተከበረ ሰው ነበረ። እናቱ «በሥቃይ ነው የወለድኩት» ብላ ያቤጽ የሚል ስም አወጣችለት።
am.R: ያቤጽ ከወንድሞቹ ይበልጥ የተከበረ ነበር። በተወለደ ጊዜ እናቱ ያቤጽ ብላ ጠራችው፤ «ስወልደው በጣም ተሠቃየሁ» ብላ ነበርና።

hi.L: और याबेस अपने भाइयों से अधिक प्रतिष्ठित था, और उसकी माता ने यह कहकर उसका नाम याबेस रखा, "क्योंकि मैंने [उसे] पीड़ा के साथ जना।"
hi.B: याबेस अपने भाइयों से अधिक सम्मानित था। उसकी माता ने उसका नाम याबेस रखा, क्योंकि उसने कहा, "मैंने उसे पीड़ा के साथ जना।"
hi.R: याबेस का अपने भाइयों से अधिक आदर होता था। जब वह पैदा हुआ, तब उसकी माँ ने उसका नाम याबेस रखा। उसने कहा, "इसके जन्म के समय मुझे बहुत पीड़ा हुई।"

ru.L: И Иавец был почитаем больше своих братьев, и его мать назвала его имя Иавец, говоря: «Ибо я родила [его] в боли.»
ru.B: Иавец был в большем почёте, чем его братья. Мать дала ему имя Иавец, потому что сказала: «Я родила его в муках.»
ru.R: Иавеца уважали больше, чем его братьев. Когда он родился, мать назвала его Иавец. Она сказала: «Его рождение было для меня очень мучительным.»

ja.L: そしてヤベツは彼の兄弟たちよりも重んじられていた。そして彼の母は彼の名をヤベツと呼んで言った。「わたしが苦しみのうちに[彼を]産んだからだ。」
ja.B: ヤベツは兄弟たちの中でもいちばん重んじられていた。母が彼をヤベツと名づけたのは、「わたしは苦しみのうちにこの子を産んだ」と言ったからである。
ja.R: ヤベツは、兄弟たちよりも尊敬されていました。ヤベツが生まれたとき、母親はその子をヤベツと名づけて言いました。「この子を産むのは、とても苦しかった。」

uk.L: І був Ябец шанованіший за своїх братів; і мати його назвала його імʼя Ябец, кажучи: «Бо я народила [його] в болю.»
uk.B: Ябец мав більшу шану, ніж його брати. Мати дала йому імʼя Ябец, бо сказала: «Я народила його в болю.»
uk.R: Ябеца поважали більше, ніж його братів. Коли він народився, мати назвала його Ябец. Вона сказала: «Його народження завдало мені великого болю.»

decisions.choice: Jabez ... in pain: a play on the name
decisions.reason: The name Jabez (ya'bets) sounds like the word for "pain" ('otsev) with two of its letters in reverse order. His mother named him after the pain of his birth, much as Rachel named her dying child Ben-oni, "son of my sorrow" (Genesis 35:18); the same word family is used of the pain of childbirth in Genesis 3:16. A name like this seemed to set a mark on a life, which is why Jabez prays as he does in verse 10.

decisions.choice: more honored: of greater standing and respect
decisions.reason: The word describes a man held in esteem. The writer does not say why; his prayer in the next verse is the only thing told about him. A place called Jabez is named in 2:55, where families of scribes lived, but its link with this man is not stated.

decisions.choice: his mother called: an earlier event told as background
decisions.reason: The naming took place at his birth, long before the prayer; the clause gives the background to it.

decisions.choice: held in greater honor; His birth was very painful for me
decisions.reason: Balanced says "held in greater honor" to keep the sense of standing. Readable says "respected" and puts the mother's words in plain modern form.

decisions.choice: "Jabes" ... "con dolor"
decisions.reason: The name sounds like the Hebrew word for "pain" (m1); Spanish cannot keep the play, which the meaning decision explains, and keeps "dolor" here and in the prayer of verse 10 so the echo is still heard.

decisions.choice: the plus-que-parfait "lui avait donné" for the naming
decisions.reason: The naming happened before the time of the first clause (m3); French marks the earlier event with the plus-que-parfait.

decisions.choice: uchungu (pain)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on Jabez and the word for pain; Swahili cannot keep the sound play, so the meaning note carries it. "Uchungu" is the word for the pains of childbirth.

decisions.choice: the name kept, the sound play left to the meaning note
decisions.reason: The name Jabez sounds like the Hebrew word for "pain"; Vietnamese cannot copy the sound, so every level keeps the name and the mother's words, as the English does, and the meaning decision explains the play.

decisions.choice: "고통" for the pain the name echoes
decisions.reason: The name Jabez sounds like the Hebrew word for pain (m1); Korean keeps the name and says the pain plainly ("고통", Readable "아팠다"), and the prayer of verse 10 echoes it with "고통" and "아프게".

decisions.choice: Jabez; com dor (L, B); me causou muita dor (R)
alternatives: Jabez, que lembra a palavra "dor" (in the text)
decisions.reason: The name keeps the form Brazilian readers know, "Jabez". In Hebrew it sounds like the word for "pain" with two letters turned round (m1); no Portuguese word sounds like it, so the play cannot be heard, and, as in the English, no level explains it in the text: the meaning note does. Every level keeps the word "dor", which comes back in Jabez's prayer in verse 10 ("para que não me cause dor"), so that the reader can see the link the two verses make (verse 10, m4).

decisions.choice: era mais respeitado
decisions.reason: Balanced says "respeitado", the word for a man held in esteem by others (m2); "honrado" in Brazilian Portuguese now suggests honesty more than standing. Literal keeps "honrado".

decisions.choice: "ሥቃይ", "ተሠቃየሁ" for the pain of his birth
decisions.reason: Verse 10 asks that harm "may not pain me" with a verb from the same word family (m4); Amharic uses "ሥቃይ" here and "እንዳልሠቃይ" there so that the reader can hear the echo, since the play on the name itself (m1) cannot be heard in Amharic. The two verses are drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, not from an existing Amharic Bible.

decisions.choice: Иавец
decisions.reason: The name sounds like the Hebrew word for pain, the play the meaning decision notes (m1); Russian keeps the name and lets the mother's words give the reason, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "苦しみ" for the pain; the sound play between the name and the word cannot be kept in Japanese
decisions.reason: The meaning decision's footnote explains the play; the Japanese says the mother's reason plainly. She speaks plain style, naming her own child.

decisions.choice: "Ябец" kept as a name, with the wordplay carried by "в болю"
alternatives: a footnote explaining the sound of the name
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name sounds like the word for pain; Ukrainian cannot echo it, so the mother's words carry the meaning, as in the English.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יַ֠עְבֵּץ לֵאלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־בָּרֵ֨ךְ תְּבָרֲכֵ֜נִי וְהִרְבִּ֤יתָ אֶת־גְּבוּלִי֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה יָדְךָ֙ עִמִּ֔י וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מֵּרָעָ֖ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י עָצְבִּ֑י וַיָּבֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Jabez to [the] God of Israel, saying, If blessing you will bless me, and you will increase my border, and will be your hand with me, and you will make [me] from harm not to pain me; and brought God what he asked.

en.L: And Jabez called to [the] God of Israel, saying, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will indeed bless me, and increase my border, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand will be with me, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will keep [me] from harm, so that it might not pain me!" And God brought about what he had asked.
en.B: Jabez called on the God of Israel: "If only {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would bless me richly and enlarge my border! If only {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand would be with me, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would keep me from harm, so that it might not pain me!" And God gave him what he had asked.
en.R: Jabez prayed to the God of Israel. He said, "Please bless me greatly and give me more land. Be with me and help me. Keep me safe from harm, so that it will not cause me pain." And God gave him what he asked for.

es.L: Y Jabes invocó al Dios de Israel, diciendo: «¡Si de verdad me bendijeras, y ensancharas mi territorio, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano estuviera conmigo, y me guardaras del mal, para que no me causara dolor!». Y Dios hizo venir lo que había pedido.
es.B: Jabes invocó al Dios de Israel: «¡Ojalá me bendijeras abundantemente y ensancharas mi territorio! ¡Ojalá {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano estuviera conmigo y me guardaras del mal, para que no me causara dolor!». Y Dios le concedió lo que había pedido.
es.R: Jabes oró al Dios de Israel. Le dijo: «Por favor, bendíceme mucho y dame más tierra. Acompáñame y ayúdame. Protégeme del mal, para que no sufra dolor». Y Dios le concedió lo que pidió.

fr.L: Et Yabets invoqua le Dieu d’Israël, disant : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me bénis vraiment, et agrandis mon territoire, et [si] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main est avec moi, et [si] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me gardes du malheur, pour qu’il ne me fasse pas souffrir ! » Et Dieu fit venir ce qu’il avait demandé.
fr.B: Yabets invoqua le Dieu d’Israël : « Si seulement {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me bénissais largement et agrandissais mon territoire ! Si seulement {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main était avec moi, et si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me gardais du malheur, pour qu’il ne me fasse pas souffrir ! » Et Dieu lui accorda ce qu’il avait demandé.
fr.R: Yabets a prié le Dieu d’Israël. Il a dit : « Bénis-moi beaucoup, s’il te plaît, et donne-moi plus de terres. Sois avec moi et aide-moi. Protège-moi du malheur, pour que je ne souffre pas. » Et Dieu lui a donné ce qu’il avait demandé.

sw.L: Na Yabesi akamwita Mungu wa Israeli, akisema, "Ikiwa utanibariki kweli kweli, na kupanua mpaka wangu, na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ukawa pamoja nami, na ukanilinda na madhara, yasije yakaniumiza!" Na Mungu akaleta kile alichoomba.
sw.B: Yabesi alimwomba Mungu wa Israeli: "Laiti ungenibariki sana na kupanua mpaka wangu! Laiti mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ungekuwa pamoja nami, nawe ukanilinda na madhara, yasije yakaniumiza!" Naye Mungu akampa kile alichoomba.
sw.R: Yabesi aliomba kwa Mungu wa Israeli. Alisema, "Tafadhali unibariki sana na unipe nchi zaidi. Uwe pamoja nami na unisaidie. Unilinde na madhara, ili yasiniletee maumivu." Naye Mungu akampa kile alichoomba.

vi.L: Và Gia-bê kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, rằng: "Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật sẽ ban phước cho con, và mở rộng bờ cõi của con, và tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở cùng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gìn giữ [con] khỏi tai họa, để nó không làm con đau đớn!" Và Đức Chúa Trời làm thành điều ông đã cầu xin.
vi.B: Gia-bê kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Ước gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban phước dồi dào cho con và mở rộng bờ cõi của con! Ước gì tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở cùng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gìn giữ con khỏi tai họa, để con khỏi phải đau đớn!" Và Đức Chúa Trời ban cho ông điều ông đã cầu xin.
vi.R: Gia-bê cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông thưa: "Xin ban phước dồi dào cho con và cho con thêm đất đai. Xin ở cùng con và giúp đỡ con. Xin gìn giữ con khỏi tai họa, để con không phải chịu đau đớn." Và Đức Chúa Trời ban cho ông điều ông cầu xin.

ko.L: 그리고 야베스가 이스라엘의 하나님께 부르짖어 말했다. "주께서 참으로 저에게 복을 주시고 제 지경을 넓혀 주시며, 주님의 손이 저와 함께 있어, 저를 해악에서 [지켜] 그것이 저를 아프게 하지 않게 하신다면!" 그리고 하나님께서 그가 구한 것을 이루어 주셨다.
ko.B: 야베스가 이스라엘의 하나님께 부르짖었다. "주께서 저에게 넘치도록 복을 주시고 제 지경을 넓혀 주신다면 얼마나 좋겠습니까! 주님의 손이 저와 함께하셔서 저를 해악에서 지켜 주시고, 제가 고통을 겪지 않게 해 주신다면 얼마나 좋겠습니까!" 그러자 하나님께서 그가 구한 것을 주셨다.
ko.R: 야베스는 이스라엘의 하나님께 기도했다. "저에게 큰 복을 주시고, 저에게 땅을 더 주십시오. 저와 함께 계시며 저를 도와주십시오. 저를 해로운 일에서 지켜 주셔서, 제가 고통을 겪지 않게 해 주십시오." 그러자 하나님께서 그가 구한 것을 주셨다.

pt.L: E Jabez clamou ao Deus de Israel, dizendo: "Se {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} de fato me abençoares, e alargares o meu território, e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão estiver comigo, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [me] guardares do mal, para que não me cause dor!" E Deus fez acontecer o que ele tinha pedido.
pt.B: Jabez invocou o Deus de Israel: "Ah, se {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me abençoasses ricamente e alargasses o meu território! Se a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão estivesse comigo, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me guardasses do mal, para que ele não me causasse dor!" E Deus lhe concedeu o que ele tinha pedido.
pt.R: Jabez orou ao Deus de Israel. Ele disse: "Por favor, abençoa-me muito e dá-me mais terra. Fica comigo e ajuda-me. Guarda-me do mal, para que nada me cause dor." E Deus lhe deu o que ele pediu.

am.L: ያቤጽም የእስራኤልን አምላክ እንዲህ ብሎ ጠራ፦ «በእርግጥ ብትባርከኝ፣ ድንበሬንም ብታሰፋልኝ፣ እጅህም ከእኔ ጋር ብትሆን፣ ክፉም እንዳይነካኝና እንዳልሠቃይ ብትጠብቀኝ!» እግዚአብሔርም የለመነውን አደረገለት።
am.B: ያቤጽ ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ፦ «ምነው አብዝተህ ብትባርከኝ፣ ድንበሬንም ብታሰፋልኝ! ምነው እጅህ ከእኔ ጋር ብትሆን፣ እንዳልሠቃይም ከጉዳት ብትጠብቀኝ!» እግዚአብሔርም የለመነውን ሰጠው።
am.R: ያቤጽ ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ ጸለየ። እንዲህም አለ፦ «እባክህ፣ አብዝተህ ባርከኝ፤ ተጨማሪ መሬትም ስጠኝ። ከእኔ ጋር ሁን፤ እርዳኝም። እንዳልሠቃይ ከጉዳት ጠብቀኝ።» እግዚአብሔርም የለመነውን ሰጠው።

hi.L: और याबेस ने इस्राएल के परमेश्वर को पुकारा, और कहा, "यदि तू सचमुच मुझे आशीष दे, और मेरी सीमा बढ़ाए, और तेरा हाथ मेरे साथ रहे, और तू [मुझे] हानि से बचाए रखे, कि वह मुझे पीड़ा न दे!" और परमेश्वर ने वह पूरा किया जो उसने माँगा था।
hi.B: याबेस ने इस्राएल के परमेश्वर को पुकारा, "काश, तू मुझे भरपूर आशीष देता और मेरी सीमा बढ़ाता! काश, तेरा हाथ मेरे साथ रहता, और तू मुझे हानि से बचाए रखता, कि वह मुझे पीड़ा न दे!" और परमेश्वर ने उसे वह दिया जो उसने माँगा था।
hi.R: याबेस ने इस्राएल के परमेश्वर से प्रार्थना की। उसने कहा, "मुझे बहुत आशीष दे, और मुझे और ज़मीन दे। मेरे साथ रह और मेरी सहायता कर। मुझे हानि से सुरक्षित रख, ताकि मुझे कोई पीड़ा न पहुँचे।" और परमेश्वर ने उसे वह दिया जो उसने माँगा था।

ru.L: И воззвал Иавец к Богу Израиля, говоря: «Если {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} действительно благословишь меня, и расширишь мои пределы, и {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} рука будет со мной, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сохранишь [меня] от зла, чтобы оно не причинило мне боли!» И Бог дал [ему] то, о чём он просил.
ru.B: Иавец воззвал к Богу Израиля: «О, если бы {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} щедро благословил меня и расширил мои пределы! О, если бы {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} рука была со мной и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} хранил меня от беды, чтобы она не причинила мне боли!» И Бог дал ему то, о чём он просил.
ru.R: Иавец помолился Богу Израиля. Он сказал: «Пожалуйста, благослови меня щедро и дай мне больше земли. Будь со мной и помогай мне. Храни меня от беды, чтобы она не причинила мне боли.» И Бог дал ему то, о чём он просил.

ja.L: そしてヤベツはイスラエルの神に呼びかけて言った。「もしあなたが本当にわたしを祝福し、わたしの境界を広げ、あなたの手がわたしと共にあり、わたしを災いから守って、それがわたしを苦しめることのないようにしてくださるなら！」そして神は、彼が願ったことをかなえられた。
ja.B: ヤベツはイスラエルの神に呼び求めた。「どうか、わたしを豊かに祝福し、わたしの境界を広げてください。どうか、あなたの手がわたしと共にあり、わたしを災いから守って、苦しむことのないようにしてくださいますように。」神は、彼が願ったことをかなえられた。
ja.R: ヤベツは、イスラエルの神に祈りました。「どうか、わたしを大いに祝福して、もっと多くの土地を与えてください。わたしと共にいて、助けてください。災いから守って、わたしが苦しむことのないようにしてください。」すると神は、ヤベツが願ったとおりにしてくださいました。

uk.L: І закликав Ябец до Бога Ізраїля, кажучи: «Якби {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} справді благословив мене, і поширив мої межі, і {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} рука була зі мною, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вберіг [мене] від лиха, щоб воно не завдало мені болю!» І Бог учинив те, чого він просив.
uk.B: Ябец закликав Бога Ізраїля: «Якби ж {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} щедро благословив мене і поширив мої межі! Якби ж {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} рука була зі мною, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вберіг мене від лиха, щоб воно не завдало мені болю!» І Бог дав йому те, чого він просив.
uk.R: Ябец молився Богові Ізраїля. Він сказав: «Будь ласка, щедро благослови мене і дай мені більше землі. Будь зі мною і допомагай мені. Бережи мене від лиха, щоб воно не завдало мені болю.» І Бог дав йому те, чого він просив.

decisions.choice: If you will bless me ...: a wish, with no "then" clause
alternatives: a vow whose promise is left unspoken
decisions.reason: The prayer is built like an oath or vow, "If you will ...", but no conclusion follows. The form is used for an earnest wish ("if only"). It may also be a vow whose promise is left unspoken, as in Jacob's vow at Genesis 28:20-22. The doubled verb, "blessing you will bless", makes the request strong.

decisions.choice: enlarge my border: give me more land
decisions.reason: "Border" is the boundary of a person's or tribe's land, and so the land itself. To enlarge it is to give more territory, as God promised Israel (Exodus 34:24; Deuteronomy 12:20). In a chapter about clans and their towns, Jabez asks for room for his family to live.

decisions.choice: your hand be with me: your power help and protect me
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power. For someone's hand to be "with" a person means to give them support (2 Samuel 3:12).

decisions.choice: keep from harm, so that it might not pain me: an echo of his name
decisions.reason: The verb "pain" ('atsav) comes from the same word family as the "pain" in his mother's words (verse 9). Jabez asks that the pain marked in his name will not shape his life; and God grants the request.

decisions.choice: If only
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew "if" as "If only", which in English carries the sense of a wish. Literal keeps "If" and ends with an exclamation mark, since the conclusion is never spoken.

decisions.choice: give me more land; Be with me and help me; Keep me safe
decisions.reason: Readable explains "border" and "your hand with me" in plain words and turns the wishes into requests.

decisions.choice: "¡Si ...!" (L); "¡Ojalá ...!" (B); requests in the imperative (R)
decisions.reason: The prayer is an "if" with no "then" clause, an earnest wish (m1). Literal keeps "Si" with an exclamation; Balanced says "Ojalá", the Spanish word for a wish; Readable turns the wishes into requests, as the English does. The deity_pronoun span is on the written "tu"; verb endings carry no span.

decisions.choice: "Si seulement ..." with the imparfait
decisions.reason: French expresses an open wish with "si seulement" and the imparfait, as the English "If only"; the Hebrew has no "then" clause (m1).

decisions.choice: "pour que je ne souffre pas"
alternatives: "pour que la douleur ne m'atteigne pas"
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the link with the pain of verse 9, where the name Yabets is explained (m4).

decisions.choice: Laiti ... ! (a wish)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "if" has no "then" clause; it is a wish, which Swahili says with "laiti". Literal keeps "Ikiwa" (if) and ends with an exclamation mark.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun span on "wako" in "mkono wako" only
decisions.reason: Swahili marks "you" in the verbs (utanibariki, ukanilinda), where no capital can stand, so only the free possessive takes the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: Jabez says "con" for himself and "Ngài" for God
decisions.reason: The prayer form of the Vietnamese Old Testament: a person praying calls himself "con" and God "Ngài" (with the deity_pronoun span) or "Chúa". Readable uses "Xin ...", the plain way to ask God.

decisions.choice: "Ước gì" for the "if" of an earnest wish
decisions.reason: The "if" clause has no "then"; Balanced makes it a wish, as the English "If only" does.

decisions.choice: prayer in 합쇼체 with "주께서", "주님의" and "저", no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Psalms, the one praying speaks to God in 합쇼체, calling God "주님" and himself "저"; Korean has no capitals, so the English "you/You" span has no Korean counterpart.

decisions.choice: "...주신다면 얼마나 좋겠습니까!" for "If only"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "if" has no "then" clause (m1); Balanced says it as a wish in Korean, as the English "If only" does, and Literal keeps the bare "if" clause with an exclamation mark.

decisions.choice: tu (Jabez to God), with deity_pronoun spans on "tu" and "tua"; Se ... (L); Ah, se ... (B); Por favor ... (R)
decisions.reason: Jabez speaks to God, so every level uses "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4). The prayer is a wish with no "then" clause (m1): Literal keeps the bare "Se" with the future subjunctive and ends with an exclamation mark, as the English does; Balanced says "Ah, se" with the imperfect subjunctive, the Portuguese way of voicing an earnest wish; Readable turns the wishes into requests with the "tu" imperative ("abençoa-me", "dá-me", "guarda-me"). Readable has no pronoun for God to carry a span, as in the English.

decisions.choice: o meu território (L, B), mais terra (R); para que não me cause dor
decisions.reason: The "border" is the land inside it (m2); "território" says that at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says "mais terra", as the English Readable says "more land". The last words keep "dor", the word of verse 9, since the verb echoes his name (m4).

decisions.choice: "…ብትባርከኝ … ብትጠብቀኝ!" (L); "ምነው … ብትባርከኝ!" (B), a wish with no "then" clause
alternatives: a conditional with a supplied conclusion
decisions.reason: The prayer is an "if" with no conclusion (m1). Literal keeps the bare conditional verbs and ends on "!"; Balanced uses "ምነው", the Amharic way of saying "if only", which carries the wish as the English "If only" does. Readable turns the wishes into requests, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "የእስራኤል አምላክ"; "እግዚአብሔር" for God (Elohim) where the one God is meant
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets: "the God of Israel" is "የእስራኤል አምላክ", and Elohim standing alone for the one God, with no divine name beside it, is "እግዚአብሔር". "Border" is "ድንበር" at Literal and Balanced and "መሬት" (land) at Readable, following the meaning note (m2).

decisions.choice: "तू", "तेरा", with no deity_pronoun span
alternatives: a deity_pronoun span as in the English
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans; Jabez addresses God with "तू", the intimate address of Hindi prayer, at every level, and the narrative speaks of God with the honorific plural.

decisions.choice: "पीड़ा" in both verses 9 and 10
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on Jabez's name with the word for pain in verse 9 and the verb "to pain" in verse 10. Hindi cannot copy the sound play, but it keeps the echo by using the same word "पीड़ा" in both verses.

decisions.choice: О, если бы
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew 'if' as a wish, as the English 'If only' does; Literal keeps a plain Если, and Readable turns the wishes into requests.

decisions.choice: Jabez prays in です・ます with "〜してください"; God's answer narrated with a light respect form ("かなえられた", R "してくださいました")
decisions.reason: People speak to God politely and the narrator uses light respect forms for God (style guide 4, OT supplement). The Literal keeps the open "if" wish ("〜してくださるなら！"); Balanced and Readable say it as a request, as the English "If only" and "Please".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; "あなた" plainly
decisions.reason: Japanese has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have no Japanese counterpart (style guide 7).

decisions.choice: "Якби (ж) ти...!" for the wish with no "then" clause
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the conditional as a wish; Ukrainian "якби" with an exclamation says the same without inventing an ending.

source.text: וּכְל֥וּב אֲחִֽי־שׁוּחָ֖ה הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־מְחִ֑יר ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י אֶשְׁתּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Chelub [the] brother of Shuhah begot Mehir; he [was the] father of Eshton.

en.L: And Chelub, [the] brother of Shuhah, begot Mehir; he [was the] father of Eshton.
en.B: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
en.R: Chelub, Shuhah's brother, had a son named Mehir. Mehir was the father of Eshton.

es.L: Y Quelub, [el] hermano de Súha, engendró a Mehir; él [fue el] padre de Estón.
es.B: Quelub, hermano de Súha, fue padre de Mehir, que fue padre de Estón.
es.R: Quelub, el hermano de Súha, tuvo un hijo llamado Mehir. Mehir fue padre de Estón.

fr.L: Et Keloub, frère de Shouha, engendra Mehir ; il [fut le] père d’Eshton.
fr.B: Keloub, frère de Shouha, fut le père de Mehir, qui fut le père d’Eshton.
fr.R: Keloub, le frère de Shouha, a eu un fils, Mehir. Mehir a eu pour fils Eshton.

sw.L: Na Kelubu, ndugu wa Shuha, alimzaa Mehiri; yeye [alikuwa] baba wa Eshtoni.
sw.B: Kelubu ndugu wa Shuha alikuwa baba wa Mehiri, aliyekuwa baba wa Eshtoni.
sw.R: Kelubu, ndugu yake Shuha, alikuwa na mwana aitwaye Mehiri. Mehiri alikuwa baba wa Eshtoni.

vi.L: Và Kê-lúp, anh em của Su-ha, sinh Mê-hia; ông [là] cha của Ê-tôn.
vi.B: Kê-lúp, anh em của Su-ha, là cha của Mê-hia, và Mê-hia là cha của Ê-tôn.
vi.R: Kê-lúp, anh em của Su-ha, có một con trai tên là Mê-hia. Mê-hia là cha của Ê-tôn.

ko.L: 그리고 수하의 형제 글룹이 메힐을 낳았다. 그는 에스돈의 아버지이다.
ko.B: 수하의 형제 글룹은 메힐을 낳았고, 메힐은 에스돈의 아버지였다.
ko.R: 수하의 형제 글룹에게는 메힐이라는 아들이 있었다. 메힐은 에스돈을 낳았다.

pt.L: E Quelube, [o] irmão de Suá, gerou Meir; ele [foi o] pai de Estom.
pt.B: Quelube, irmão de Suá, foi o pai de Meir, que foi o pai de Estom.
pt.R: Quelube, irmão de Suá, teve um filho chamado Meir. Meir foi o pai de Estom.

am.L: የሹሐ ወንድም ክሉብም መሒርን ወለደ፤ እርሱም የኤሽቶን አባት [ነበረ]።
am.B: የሹሐ ወንድም ክሉብ የመሒር አባት ነበረ፤ መሒርም የኤሽቶን አባት ነበረ።
am.R: የሹሐ ወንድም ክሉብ መሒር የተባለ ልጅ ነበረው። መሒር የኤሽቶን አባት ነበረ።

hi.L: और शूहा के भाई कलूब ने महीर को उत्पन्न किया; वह एशतोन का पिता [था]।
hi.B: शूहा का भाई कलूब महीर का पिता था, जो एशतोन का पिता था।
hi.R: शूहा के भाई कलूब का एक बेटा हुआ, जिसका नाम महीर था। महीर एशतोन का पिता था।

ru.L: И Хелув, брат Шухи, родил Мехира; он [был] отцом Эштона.
ru.B: Хелув, брат Шухи, был отцом Мехира, который был отцом Эштона.
ru.R: У Хелува, брата Шухи, был сын по имени Мехир. Мехир был отцом Эштона.

ja.L: そしてシュハの兄弟ケルブはメヒルをもうけた。彼はエシュトンの父[であった]。
ja.B: シュハの兄弟ケルブはメヒルの父となった。メヒルはエシュトンの父である。
ja.R: シュハの兄弟ケルブには、メヒルという息子がいました。メヒルはエシュトンの父でした。

uk.L: І Келув, брат Шухи, породив Мехіра; він — батько Ештона.
uk.B: Келув, брат Шухи, був батьком Мехіра, а той був батьком Ештона.
uk.R: Келув, брат Шухи, мав сина на імʼя Мехір. Мехір був батьком Ештона.

decisions.choice: Chelub the brother of Shuhah: a man known by his brother
decisions.reason: This Chelub is told apart from others by naming his brother, so he is probably not the Chelubai (Caleb) of 2:9. How his family joins the rest of Judah is not said. Eshton here is a person, since he has sons in verse 12, so "father" has its ordinary sense.

decisions.choice: had a son named Mehir. Mehir was
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the chain of names into two short sentences.

source.text: וְאֶשְׁתּ֗וֹן הוֹלִ֞יד אֶת־בֵּ֤ית רָפָא֙ וְאֶת־פָּסֵ֔חַ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּ֖ה אֲבִ֣י עִ֣יר נָחָ֑שׁ אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֥י רֵכָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And Eshton begot Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah [the] father of Ir-nahash; these [were the] men of Recah.

en.L: And Eshton begot Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah [the] father of Ir-nahash. These [were the] men of Recah.
en.B: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
en.R: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah. Tehinnah was the founder of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.

es.L: Y Estón engendró a Bet-rafa, y a Paseah, y a Tehina, [el] padre de Ir-nahas. Estos [fueron los] hombres de Reca.
es.B: Estón fue padre de Bet-rafa, de Paseah y de Tehina, padre de Ir-nahas. Estos fueron los hombres de Reca.
es.R: Estón fue padre de Bet-rafa, Paseah y Tehina. Tehina fue el fundador de Ir-nahas. Estos fueron los hombres de Reca.

fr.L: Et Eshton engendra Beth-Rapha, et Paséah, et Tehinna, père d’Ir-Nahash. Ce [sont] les hommes de Réka.
fr.B: Eshton fut le père de Beth-Rapha, de Paséah, et de Tehinna, père d’Ir-Nahash. Ce sont les hommes de Réka.
fr.R: Eshton a eu pour fils Beth-Rapha, Paséah et Tehinna. Tehinna a été le fondateur d’Ir-Nahash. Ce sont les hommes de Réka.

sw.L: Na Eshtoni alimzaa Beth-rafa, na Pasea, na Tehina baba wa Ir-nahashi. Hawa [walikuwa] watu wa Reka.
sw.B: Eshtoni alikuwa baba wa Beth-rafa, Pasea, na Tehina baba wa Ir-nahashi. Hao ndio waliokuwa watu wa Reka.
sw.R: Eshtoni alikuwa baba wa Beth-rafa, Pasea na Tehina. Tehina alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Ir-nahashi. Hao ndio waliokuwa watu wa Reka.

vi.L: Và Ê-tôn sinh Bết-Ra-pha, Pha-sê-a, và Tê-hi-na cha của Y-na-hách. Đó [là] những người Rê-ca.
vi.B: Ê-tôn là cha của Bết-Ra-pha, Pha-sê-a, và Tê-hi-na, cha của Y-na-hách. Đó là những người Rê-ca.
vi.R: Ê-tôn là cha của Bết-Ra-pha, Pha-sê-a và Tê-hi-na. Tê-hi-na là người lập ra thành Y-na-hách. Đó là những người Rê-ca.

ko.L: 그리고 에스돈은 벧라바와 바세아와 이르나하스의 아버지 드힌나를 낳았다. 이들이 레가 사람들이다.
ko.B: 에스돈은 벧라바와 바세아와 이르나하스의 아버지 드힌나를 낳았다. 이들이 레가 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 에스돈은 벧라바, 바세아, 드힌나를 낳았다. 드힌나는 이르나하스를 세운 사람이다. 이들이 레가 사람들이었다.

pt.L: E Estom gerou Bete-Rafa, e Paseia, e Teína, [o] pai de Ir-Naás. Estes [eram os] homens de Reca.
pt.B: Estom foi o pai de Bete-Rafa, de Paseia e de Teína, o pai de Ir-Naás. Esses foram os homens de Reca.
pt.R: Estom foi o pai de Bete-Rafa, Paseia e Teína. Teína foi o fundador de Ir-Naás. Esses foram os homens de Reca.

am.L: ኤሽቶንም ቤትራፋን፣ ፋሴሐንና የዒርናሐሽን አባት ተሒናን ወለደ። እነዚህ የሬካ ሰዎች [ነበሩ]።
am.B: ኤሽቶን የቤትራፋ፣ የፋሴሐና የዒርናሐሽ አባት የሆነው የተሒና አባት ነበረ። እነዚህ የሬካ ሰዎች ነበሩ።
am.R: ኤሽቶን የቤትራፋ፣ የፋሴሐና የተሒና አባት ነበረ። ተሒና የዒርናሐሽ ከተማ መሥራች ነበረ። እነዚህ የሬካ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और एशतोन ने बेत-रापा, और पासेह, और ईर-नाहाश के पिता तहिन्ना को उत्पन्न किया। ये रेका के पुरुष [थे]।
hi.B: एशतोन बेत-रापा, पासेह, और ईर-नाहाश के पिता तहिन्ना का पिता था। ये रेका के पुरुष थे।
hi.R: एशतोन बेत-रापा, पासेह और तहिन्ना का पिता था। तहिन्ना ईर-नाहाश को बसानेवाला था। ये रेका के लोग थे।

ru.L: И Эштон родил Беф-Рафу, и Пасеаха, и Техинну, отца Ир-Нахаша. Это люди Рехи.
ru.B: Эштон был отцом Беф-Рафы, Пасеаха и Техинны, отца Ир-Нахаша. Это были люди Рехи.
ru.R: Эштон был отцом Беф-Рафы, Пасеаха и Техинны. Техинна был основателем Ир-Нахаша. Это были люди Рехи.

ja.L: そしてエシュトンは、ベト・ラファ、パセア、イル・ナハシュの父テヒナをもうけた。これらがレカの人々である。
ja.B: エシュトンは、ベト・ラファ、パセア、またイル・ナハシュの父テヒナの父となった。これらがレカの人々であった。
ja.R: エシュトンは、ベト・ラファ、パセア、テヒナの父でした。テヒナは、イル・ナハシュの町を築いた人でした。この人たちが、レカの人々です。

uk.L: І Ештон породив Бет-Рафу, і Пасеаха, і Техінну, батька Ір-Нахаша. Це мужі Рехи.
uk.B: Ештон був батьком Бет-Рафи, Пасеаха і Техінни, батька Ір-Нахаша. Це були мужі Рехи.
uk.R: Ештон був батьком Бет-Рафи, Пасеаха і Техінни. Техінна був засновником Ір-Нахаша. Це були мужі Рехи.

decisions.choice: Beth-rapha and Ir-nahash: clan and town names
decisions.reason: Beth-rapha means "house of Rapha" and Ir-nahash "town of Nahash"; both look like names of places or family groups counted in the line of Eshton. Neither place is known.

decisions.choice: the men of Recah: an unknown place or group
decisions.reason: Recah is not named anywhere else. The ancient Greek translation reads "Rechab" here.

decisions.choice: founder
decisions.reason: As at verse 3.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י קְנַ֔ז עָתְנִיאֵ֖ל וּשְׂרָיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֥י עָתְנִיאֵ֖ל חֲתַֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and [the] sons of Othniel: Hathath.

en.L: And [the] sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. And [the] sons of Othniel: Hathath.
en.B: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
en.R: Kenaz's sons were Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel's sons included Hathath.

es.L: Y [los] hijos de Cenaz: Otoniel y Seraías. Y [los] hijos de Otoniel: Hatat.
es.B: Los hijos de Cenaz: Otoniel y Seraías. Los hijos de Otoniel: Hatat.
es.R: Los hijos de Cenaz fueron Otoniel y Seraías. Entre los hijos de Otoniel estaba Hatat.

fr.L: Et les fils de Kenaz : Othniel et Seraya. Et les fils d’Othniel : Hathath.
fr.B: Les fils de Kenaz : Othniel et Seraya. Les fils d’Othniel : Hathath.
fr.R: Kenaz a eu pour fils Othniel et Seraya. Parmi les fils d’Othniel, il y a eu Hathath.

sw.L: Na wana wa Kenazi: Othnieli na Seraya. Na wana wa Othnieli: Hathathi.
sw.B: Wana wa Kenazi: Othnieli na Seraya. Wana wa Othnieli: Hathathi.
sw.R: Wana wa Kenazi walikuwa Othnieli na Seraya. Mmoja wa wana wa Othnieli alikuwa Hathathi.

vi.L: Và các con trai của Kê-na: Ốt-ni-ên và Sê-ra-gia. Và các con trai của Ốt-ni-ên: Ha-thát.
vi.B: Các con trai của Kê-na là Ốt-ni-ên và Sê-ra-gia. Các con trai của Ốt-ni-ên: Ha-thát.
vi.R: Các con trai của Kê-na là Ốt-ni-ên và Sê-ra-gia. Trong số các con trai của Ốt-ni-ên có Ha-thát.

ko.L: 그리고 그나스의 아들들은 옷니엘과 스라야이다. 그리고 옷니엘의 아들들은 하닷이다.
ko.B: 그나스의 아들들은 옷니엘과 스라야였다. 옷니엘의 아들은 하닷이었다.
ko.R: 그나스의 아들들은 옷니엘과 스라야였다. 옷니엘의 아들 가운데는 하닷이 있었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Quenaz: Otniel e Seraías. E os filhos de Otniel: Hatate.
pt.B: Os filhos de Quenaz: Otniel e Seraías. Os filhos de Otniel: Hatate.
pt.R: Os filhos de Quenaz foram Otniel e Seraías. Entre os filhos de Otniel estava Hatate.

am.L: የቄኔዝም ልጆች ጎቶንያልና ሠራያ [ናቸው]። የጎቶንያልም ልጆች ሐታት [ናቸው]።
am.B: የቄኔዝ ልጆች ጎቶንያልና ሠራያ ነበሩ። የጎቶንያል ልጅ ሐታት ነበረ።
am.R: የቄኔዝ ልጆች ጎቶንያልና ሠራያ ነበሩ። ከጎቶንያል ልጆች መካከል ሐታት ይገኝበታል።

hi.L: और कनज़ के पुत्र: ओत्नीएल और सरायाह। और ओत्नीएल के पुत्र: हतत।
hi.B: कनज़ के पुत्र: ओत्नीएल और सरायाह। ओत्नीएल के पुत्र: हतत।
hi.R: कनज़ के बेटे ओत्नीएल और सरायाह थे। ओत्नीएल के बेटों में हतत था।

ru.L: И сыновья Кеназа: Гофониил и Сераия. И сыновья Гофониила: Хафаф.
ru.B: Сыновья Кеназа: Гофониил и Сераия. Сыновья Гофониила: Хафаф.
ru.R: У Кеназа были сыновья Гофониил и Сераия. Среди сыновей Гофониила был Хафаф.

ja.L: そしてケナズの子ら。オトニエルとセラヤ。そしてオトニエルの子ら。ハタト。
ja.B: ケナズの息子は、オトニエルとセラヤであった。オトニエルの息子はハタトであった。
ja.R: ケナズの息子は、オトニエルとセラヤでした。オトニエルの息子には、ハタトがいました。

uk.L: І сини Кеназа: Отніїл і Серая. І сини Отніїла: Хатат.
uk.B: Сини Кеназа: Отніїл і Серая. Сини Отніїла: Хатат.
uk.R: Синами Кеназа були Отніїл і Серая. Серед синів Отніїла був Хатат.

decisions.choice: Othniel son of Kenaz: the first judge of Israel
decisions.reason: Othniel captured Kiriath-sepher and married Caleb's daughter Achsah (Joshua 15:16-17; Judges 1:12-13), and later rescued Israel as the first of the judges (Judges 3:9-11). Kenaz's family is linked with Caleb, who is called "the Kenizzite" (Numbers 32:12).

decisions.choice: the sons of Othniel: Hathath, and perhaps Meonothai
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "sons" but gives one name. The ancient Greek translation adds "and Meonothai", the name that begins the next verse, so a name may have dropped out in copying.

decisions.choice: included
decisions.reason: Readable says "included" since only one name follows the plural "sons" (see the text note).

decisions.choice: Otniel, Quenaz
decisions.reason: The first judge (m1) keeps the forms of Joshua 15:17 and Judges 1:13 in Portuguese. Readable says "Entre os filhos ... estava", since only one name follows the plural (m2), as the English says "included".

decisions.choice: "የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል", as Joshua 15:17 and Judges 3:9
decisions.reason: Othniel son of Kenaz is the first judge (m1), and keeps the Amharic names of Joshua and Judges.

source.text: וּמְעוֹנֹתַ֖י הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עָפְרָ֑ה וּשְׂרָיָ֗ה הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־יוֹאָב֙ אֲבִי֙ גֵּ֣יא חֲרָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י חֲרָשִׁ֖ים הָיֽוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And Meonothai begot Ophrah; and Seraiah begot Joab [the] father of Ge-harashim, for craftsmen they were.

en.L: And Meonothai begot Ophrah, and Seraiah begot Joab, [the] father of Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen.
en.B: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge-harashim, the Valley of Craftsmen, for its people were craftsmen.
en.R: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the founder of Ge-harashim. Its name means Valley of Craftsmen, because the people there were skilled workers.

es.L: Y Meonotai engendró a Ofra, y Seraías engendró a Joab, [el] padre de Ge-harasim, porque eran artesanos.
es.B: Meonotai fue padre de Ofra. Seraías fue padre de Joab, padre de Ge-harasim, el valle de los Artesanos, porque su gente era artesana.
es.R: Meonotai fue padre de Ofra. Seraías fue padre de Joab, el fundador de Ge-harasim. Ese nombre significa «valle de los Artesanos», porque la gente de allí eran trabajadores hábiles.

fr.L: Et Méonothaï engendra Ophra, et Seraya engendra Joab, père de Gué-Harashim, car ils étaient artisans.
fr.B: Méonothaï fut le père d’Ophra. Seraya fut le père de Joab, père de Gué-Harashim, la vallée des Artisans, car ses habitants étaient artisans.
fr.R: Méonothaï a eu pour fils Ophra. Seraya a eu pour fils Joab, le fondateur de Gué-Harashim. Ce nom veut dire « vallée des Artisans », parce que les gens de cet endroit étaient des ouvriers habiles.

sw.L: Na Meonothai alimzaa Ofra, na Seraya alimzaa Yoabu, baba wa Ge-harashimu, kwa maana walikuwa mafundi.
sw.B: Meonothai alikuwa baba wa Ofra. Seraya alikuwa baba wa Yoabu, baba wa Ge-harashimu, yaani Bonde la Mafundi, kwa maana watu wake walikuwa mafundi.
sw.R: Meonothai alikuwa baba wa Ofra. Seraya alikuwa baba wa Yoabu, mwanzilishi wa Ge-harashimu. Jina hilo maana yake ni Bonde la Mafundi, kwa sababu watu wa huko walikuwa mafundi stadi.

vi.L: Và Mê-ô-nô-thai sinh Óp-ra, và Sê-ra-gia sinh Giô-áp, cha của Ghê-Ha-ra-sim, vì họ là thợ thủ công.
vi.B: Mê-ô-nô-thai là cha của Óp-ra. Sê-ra-gia là cha của Giô-áp, cha của Ghê-Ha-ra-sim, tức là Thung Lũng Thợ Thủ Công, vì dân ở đó là thợ thủ công.
vi.R: Mê-ô-nô-thai là cha của Óp-ra. Sê-ra-gia là cha của Giô-áp, người lập ra Ghê-Ha-ra-sim. Tên này nghĩa là Thung Lũng Thợ Thủ Công, vì dân ở đó là những người thợ lành nghề.

ko.L: 그리고 므오노대는 오브라를 낳았다. 그리고 스라야는 게하라심의 아버지 요압을 낳았으니, 그들이 장인들이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 므오노대는 오브라를 낳았다. 스라야는 요압을 낳았는데, 요압은 '장인들의 골짜기'라는 뜻의 게하라심의 아버지였다. 그곳 사람들이 장인들이었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 므오노대는 오브라를 낳았다. 스라야는 요압을 낳았는데, 요압은 게하라심을 세운 사람이다. 게하라심은 '장인들의 골짜기'라는 뜻이다. 그곳 사람들이 솜씨 좋은 기술자들이었기 때문이다.

pt.L: E Meonotai gerou Ofra, e Seraías gerou Joabe, [o] pai de Ge-Harasim, porque eles eram artesãos.
pt.B: Meonotai foi o pai de Ofra. Seraías foi o pai de Joabe, o pai de Ge-Harasim, o Vale dos Artesãos, pois o seu povo era de artesãos.
pt.R: Meonotai foi o pai de Ofra. Seraías foi o pai de Joabe, o fundador de Ge-Harasim. Esse nome quer dizer Vale dos Artesãos, porque as pessoas de lá eram trabalhadores habilidosos.

am.L: መዖኖታይም ዖፍራን ወለደ፤ ሠራያም የጌሃራሺምን አባት ኢዮአብን ወለደ፤ የእጅ ጥበብ ባለሙያዎች ነበሩና።
am.B: መዖኖታይ የዖፍራ አባት ነበረ። ሠራያም የኢዮአብ አባት ነበረ፤ ኢዮአብም የጌሃራሺም፣ ማለትም የጥበበኞች ሸለቆ አባት ነበረ፤ ሕዝቡ የእጅ ጥበብ ባለሙያዎች ነበሩና።
am.R: መዖኖታይ የዖፍራ አባት ነበረ። ሠራያ የኢዮአብ አባት ነበረ፤ ኢዮአብም የጌሃራሺም መሥራች ነበረ። የስሙ ትርጉም የጥበበኞች ሸለቆ ማለት ነው፤ በዚያ የሚኖሩት ሰዎች የእጅ ጥበብ ባለሙያዎች ነበሩና።

hi.L: और मोनोतै ने ओप्रा को उत्पन्न किया, और सरायाह ने गे-हराशीम के पिता योआब को उत्पन्न किया, क्योंकि वे कारीगर थे।
hi.B: मोनोतै ओप्रा का पिता था। सरायाह योआब का पिता था, जो गे-हराशीम, यानी कारीगरों की घाटी, का पिता था, क्योंकि वहाँ के लोग कारीगर थे।
hi.R: मोनोतै ओप्रा का पिता था। सरायाह योआब का पिता था, जो गे-हराशीम को बसानेवाला था। इस नाम का अर्थ है कारीगरों की घाटी, क्योंकि वहाँ के लोग कुशल कारीगर थे।

ru.L: И Меонофай родил Офру, а Сераия родил Иоава, отца Ге-Харашима, ибо они были ремесленниками.
ru.B: Меонофай был отцом Офры. Сераия был отцом Иоава, отца Ге-Харашима, то есть Долины ремесленников, потому что её жители были ремесленниками.
ru.R: Меонофай был отцом Офры. Сераия был отцом Иоава, основателя Ге-Харашима. Это название значит Долина ремесленников, потому что люди там были искусными мастерами.

ja.L: そしてメオノタイはオフラをもうけ、セラヤはゲ・ハラシムの父ヨアブをもうけた。彼らが職人だったからである。
ja.B: メオノタイはオフラの父となった。セラヤはヨアブの父となり、ヨアブはゲ・ハラシム、すなわち職人の谷の父となった。その住民が職人だったからである。
ja.R: メオノタイはオフラの父でした。セラヤはヨアブの父で、ヨアブはゲ・ハラシムの町を築いた人でした。ゲ・ハラシムとは、職人の谷という意味です。そこの人々が、腕のいい職人だったからです。

uk.L: І Меонотай породив Офру, а Серая породив Йоава, батька Ге-Харашіма, бо вони були ремісниками.
uk.B: Меонотай був батьком Офри. Серая був батьком Йоава, батька Ге-Харашіма, тобто Долини Ремісників, бо його мешканці були ремісниками.
uk.R: Меонотай був батьком Офри. Серая був батьком Йоава, засновника Ге-Харашіма. Ця назва означає Долина Ремісників, бо люди там були вправними майстрами.

decisions.choice: Ge-harashim: "Valley of Craftsmen"
decisions.reason: The name means "valley of craftsmen", and the note "for they were craftsmen" explains it. The word names a skilled worker in wood, stone or metal. After the exile people of Benjamin lived in a valley of this name near Lod and Ono (Nehemiah 11:35).

decisions.choice: Ophrah and Joab: people of this family
decisions.reason: This Ophrah is a person or clan, not one of the towns of that name (Judges 6:11; Joshua 18:23). This Joab is not David's commander.

decisions.choice: the Valley of Craftsmen; its people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the name, which the Hebrew reader would hear, and say "its people" for the bare "they".

decisions.choice: o Vale dos Artesãos
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the name (m1), as the English does. "Artesão" is the ordinary Brazilian word for a skilled worker in wood, stone or metal; "artífice" is bookish. "Ofra" and "Joabe" keep the forms of Judges 6:11 and 2 Samuel, though these are other people (m2).

decisions.choice: "ማለትም የጥበበኞች ሸለቆ" (B); "የስሙ ትርጉም የጥበበኞች ሸለቆ ማለት ነው" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English does, Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the name, with the wording the Amharic Genesis uses for names explained in the text ("ማለትም", "ትርጉሙ … ማለት ነው").

decisions.choice: "職人の谷" given at Balanced and Readable for the meaning of Ge-harashim, without quotation brackets
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced and Readable, which explain the name without quotation marks; the Literal keeps only the reason clause.

source.text: וּבְנֵי֙ כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה עִ֥ירוּ אֵלָ֖ה וָנָ֑עַם וּבְנֵ֥י אֵלָ֖ה וּקְנַֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and [the] sons of Elah: and Kenaz.

en.L: And [the] sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. And [the] sons of Elah: and Kenaz.
en.B: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. The sons of Elah: Kenaz.
en.R: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah and Naam. Elah's descendants included Kenaz.

es.L: Y [los] hijos de Caleb hijo de Jefone: Iru, Ela, y Naam. Y [los] hijos de Ela: y Cenaz.
es.B: Los hijos de Caleb hijo de Jefone: Iru, Ela y Naam. Los hijos de Ela: Cenaz.
es.R: Los hijos de Caleb hijo de Jefone fueron Iru, Ela y Naam. Entre los descendientes de Ela estaba Cenaz.

fr.L: Et les fils de Caleb, fils de Jephounné : Irou, Éla, et Naam. Et les fils d’Éla : et Kenaz.
fr.B: Les fils de Caleb, fils de Jephounné : Irou, Éla et Naam. Les fils d’Éla : Kenaz.
